overload_type_resolution.description: Expand Build Array from 1 to 32 ordered inputs. Compatible elements must have equal or adjacent ranks. Equal rank N produces rank N+1, or rank N when Concatenate Inputs is selected. Mixed ranks N and N-1 force concatenation at rank N and lock the checked menu item. All scalars produce a 1D array and lock concatenation off. Unwired inputs supply no type evidence; without known types the output is void. Numeric leaves may promote; unrelated types cannot mix. Manual mode and input count are saved; target execution remains separately gated.
